premises.text: Connecting existing underused private bikes creates an infrastructure-light global rental system
premises.evidence_span: the largest bike rental system in the world already exists. We just need to connect it

premises.text: Web marketplace lets owners list bikes and renters find nearby options at prices averaging about half of shops
premises.evidence_span: we've created a web platform where we're taking this excess supply of bicycles and meeting it with the demand

premises.text: Safety and trust via listing review, insurance to $5,000, and facilitated owner-renter communication
premises.evidence_span: We have enough rules in place to make it safe. We insure bicycles up to $5,000

value.text: Help travelers and locals explore by renting bikes from individuals
value.evidence_span: rent out their bikes to travelers and locals looking to explore

causal_links.evidence_span: We just need to connect it

notes: Price half-of-shops folded into marketplace premise. Insurance and review/comms as one trust module. Traction excluded.
